name: parakeet-cpp
description: Parakeet (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR + Sortformer diarization) inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships CTC, TDT, EOU and Sortformer engines under one Engine umbrella, plus the cross-engine StreamEvent API (VadStateChanged / EndOfTurn). Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's parakeet-cpp/ subfolder; consumes the ggml-speech port. This pin (feat/parakeet-cpu-repack-q4 a4648f96, PR #87) places the quantized conformer encoder GEMM weights in the CPU repack extra buffer type on CPU-only runs (q4_0->q4_0_4x8, q8_0->q8_0_4x8), replacing the generic vec_dot path with the block-parallel dotprod/i8mm/AVX2 kernels and closing the CPU-side q4_0-slower-than-q8_0 penalty. Prior pin (master df54e37, PR #83) fixes the on-device TDT predictor: the 2-layer decoder LSTM only persisted its last layer's state on the GPU graph path (the others were pruned by graph construction), leaving the predictor partly stateless and dropping word-final sub-words on GPU. Prior pin (master 1d9ca83, PR #74) routes encoder, subsampling and Sortformer compute through a shared ggml_backend_sched with the CPU backend last, giving per-op CPU fallback for ops the active GPU backend cannot run; the cached encoder graph stays on a persistent gallocr (Adreno cached-graph reuse) and the TDT decoder stays on direct compute. Prior pin (master b95ad447) brought Parakeet on Mali-Vulkan GPU (PR #51): encoder reformulation (broadcast mul_mat to mul + sum_rows) and the Sortformer head on CPU with CPU-resident weight copies.
